question: What must an Express Entry arranged-employment job-offer letter contain?

claims.text: A letter from the employer(s) offering the job in Canada is required, printed on company letterhead with contact information, supervisor signature, expected start date, continuous paid full-time commitment for at least one year, job title, duties, hours per week, and annual salary plus benefits.

prose: An arranged-employment job-offer letter is required when an applicant claims arranged employment. When required, the letter must be printed on company letterhead and include the applicant's name, employer contact information, supervisor/personnel officer signature, expected start date, continuous paid full-time employment commitment for at least one year post-visa issuance, job title, duties, work hours, and annual salary plus benefits.
